veranderings.blok: Minder as 'n dag na 'n ander wêrelddeel
veranderings.na: vir sy werk na 'n ander land
veranderings.rede: 'Vir werk' echoes English 'for work'; 'vir sy werk' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing.

veranderings.voor: By die lughawe aan die ander kant klim die passasiers uit
veranderings.na: By die lughawe waar die vlug eindig, klim die passasiers uit
veranderings.rede: 'Aan die ander kant' is vague for a Grade 4 reader (other side of what?); naming the destination airport makes it clear without adding content.

veranderings.voor: 'n Satelliet kyk van bo af na die wolke
veranderings.na: Sommige satelliete kyk van bo af na die wolke
veranderings.rede: The next sentences say 'Ander satelliete' and 'Nog ander satelliete', which need a 'sommige' group to contrast with; generic ''n Satelliet' reads as all satellites. The protected word stays, only in plural.

vlae.rede: Block heading personifies cargo as being in a hurry; it is understandable, but a heading such as 'Vrag wat vinnig moet aankom' would be more natural. Not proposed as a change because headings may not be script-editable.
